name: codex-relay
description: Run OpenAI Codex threads as Claude subagents (any model + effort) and let Claude and Codex agents message each other.

defaultModel.title: Default Codex model
defaultModel.description: Model for Codex subagents when none is given; empty uses ~/.codex/config.toml.

defaultEffort.title: Default reasoning effort
defaultEffort.description: Effort for Codex subagents when none is given; 'config' uses ~/.codex/config.toml.

sandbox.title: Default Codex sandbox
sandbox.description: Sandbox for Codex subagents when none is given.

transport.title: App-server transport
transport.description: spawn: a private `codex app-server` per session. daemon: the shared local daemon (threads show in `codex agents`).

nodePath.title: Node binary
nodePath.description: Path to node for the bridge; empty resolves it from a login shell.

codexPath.title: Codex binary
codexPath.description: Path to codex; empty resolves it from a login shell.
